prompt:
The table below gives information about journeys to work in one city in 2015 and 2023, and the average time each journey took in 2023.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Journeys to work in Ardenholm by mode of transport
visual.alt: A table showing the share of transport modes for journeys to work in one city in 2015 and 2023, and the average journey time for each mode in 2023.

key_points: Car is the most common mode in both years, but its share falls from 46 to 34, the biggest drop
Bicycle's share rises from 9 to 18, doubling — the largest proportional increase
Bus or tram's share rises from 22 to 27 and takes second place in 2023
Walking falls slightly (18 → 16), while train's share stays fixed at 5
In terms of journey time, train is the longest (41 minutes) and walking the shortest (19 minutes); bicycle, the fastest-growing mode, takes only 6 minutes longer than car
The shares add up to 100 in both years
common_mistakes: Reading every cell in the table one by one instead of picking out the biggest rise and the biggest fall
Confusing the two different units (percentage share and minutes)
Looking only at the shares and never using the time column
Inventing a reason ('new cycle lanes were built') — the table gives no such information
